recurring_symptoms: Coordinating and standardizing cleaner turnover between guests is hard.
Restocking supplies and consumables is easy to forget.
Editable welcome-book/template tools fail to save or print, losing hosts' work.
root_problems: Airbnb hosts with 1-5 properties face a related cluster of problems around turnover & property operations — e.g. cleaner turnover coordination, supply restocking tracking, welcome book contents unclear.
desired_outcomes: A shared outcome across member problems: Standardize every turnover. Never run out of guest supplies. Produce a house manual without tool failures.
existing_behaviours: Buying Canva welcome-book/checklist templates on Etsy
solution_weaknesses: Canva templates fail on save/print (lost work)
customer_complaints: 'could not print after personalizing and would not save. I lost hours of work.'
unmet_needs: A turnover system that won't break like a Canva file
solution_gaps: 'Template could not be printed after personalizing and would not save. I lost hours of work.'
Existing welcome-book/checklist templates fail on save/print; reliable, foolproof turnover tooling is missing.
contradictions: Etsy welcome-book market is saturated on aesthetics; differentiation must be reliability + operational completeness, not looks.
Distribution likely harder than the product (creator ecosystem exists but promotion is unproven — see Build-4 density MEDIUM, not qualified).
opportunity_assessment: Small Airbnb hosts repeatedly need a reliable turnover system (cleaning/turnover, a guest-ready house manual, supply restocking). Observed: hosts already pay for welcome-book/checklist templates on Etsy (1,000+ listings, many Bestsellers) and a real 1-star review shows those Canva templates failing to save/print — a reliability gap. Demand and spending are real; the open question is distribution, not whether the problem exists.
